_comment: Mutation ONLY on the pure decision modules (zero I/O). legacy-mcp-inject.js/ctxroute-reset.js/lock.js are NOT mutated: I/O (fs/stdin/stdout) = integration/contract tests, never Stryker (doctrine: isolate the decision from the I/O BEFORE mutating).
_runner_comment: ⚠️ vitest MANDATORY (node:test BANNED 16/07/2026, cf stryker-runner-choice.md): perTest + live workers = zero spawn per mutant (12 min → seconds/minutes measured). NEVER go back to command/commandRunner — gate in mutation-workflow-gate.test.js. The suites launched per mutant = the ones vitest.config.mjs includes (include/exclude): new pure module ⇒ its suite MUST be discovered by vitest, not listed here.
_timeout_comment: ⚠️ ROOT CAUSE of 'the local score lies' (found 15/07/2026). Stryker default = timeoutMS 5000 + timeoutFactor 1.5 × baseline. ~5s suite ⇒ ~12s timeout. On a LOADED machine a normal 5s run exceeds 12s ⇒ TIMEOUT ⇒ Stryker counts it as KILLED ⇒ INFLATED score (measured: 100% locally with 411 timeouts / 0.17 tests per mutant, vs 97.54% in CI with 0 timeouts). Local wasn't lying by fate: this setting was missing. 60s = far above any realistic load ⇒ a timeout becomes a REAL signal again (test in an infinite loop), no longer load noise. Cost: ~0 (only TRULY infinite mutants wait). ⚠️ NEVER lower it to 'speed things up': that reintroduces the silent lie, and a false score is worse than no score.
_language_spec_comment: language-spec.js is DELIBERATELY OUTSIDE mutation (14/08/2026). It is not DECISION code but a MODEL (an executable specification), just like the data constants excluded elsewhere in the fleet. Mutating a model does not measure its quality: it measures the DOMAIN COVERAGE of the differential — and it produces genuinely EQUIVALENT mutants (e.g. norm() uppercasing instead of lowercasing: the comparison being internal to the model, the verdict is identical). The model's judge is `spec-differential.test.js`, whose NEGATIVE-CHECK on 3 engine sabotages is the real proof of liveness. 🛑 Do NOT add it to `mutate` to inflate a number: the per-file floor would then encode a false expectation.
_mutator_comment: Regex excluded (Stryker mutates regexes character-by-character = mostly noise; serverName()/toolSuffix() are covered functionally by many cases in lib-pure.test.js, not by regex mutation).
_concurrency_comment: ⚠️ BOUNDED CONCURRENCY — set 27/07/2026, DO NOT RAISE. By default Stryker opens 1 worker per logical thread (12 on a Ryzen 5 5600X): the machine saturates at 100%. DAMAGE MEASURED that day: under saturation, hook processes no longer reach the line that arms their deadline (deadline.js) ⇒ 502 zombies accumulated, machine unusable, `git log` over 60 s, suites in FALSE REDS. Mutation is BACKGROUND work, not a race: 3 workers = ~50% load, usable machine, identical result. Fleet rule: incremental + perTest + timeoutMS + bounded concurrency, on ALL projects.
_known_survivor: 99.15% measured 15/07/2026 — 1 remaining survivor (isServerActive, fallback [] → ["Stryker was here"]): an EQUIVALENT mutant in practice. That literal is only observable if a test calls isServerActive with server==='Stryker was here' (a Stryker-internal string, not a real case; coupling a test to that value would break on a future tool version). Break pinned at 99 (ratchet never lowered, maintainer doctrine) — not 100: that last point is a genuine tooling ceiling, not a test hole.
_why_mutate: ALL the PURE modules (dependency-cruiser gates guarantee zero I/O). NEVER the I/O files: equivalent mutants guaranteed.
_cadence_spec_comment: cadence-spec.js is DELIBERATELY OUTSIDE mutation (19/08/2026), for the SAME reason as language-spec.js: it is not DECISION code but an executable MODEL. Mutating a model measures the DOMAIN COVERAGE of its differential, never the model's quality, and it yields genuinely EQUIVALENT mutants (the comparison being internal to the model, many rewrites change no verdict). Its judge is `cadence-differential.test.js` and its 4 engine sabotages — that negative-check is the real proof of liveness. ⚠️ The suite IS in the Stryker vitest config, because it exercises `gate.js`, which IS mutated: 11,346 exhaustive cases killing cascade/alternation/filter mutants. 🛑 Do NOT add this file to `mutate` to inflate a number: the per-file floor would then encode a false expectation.
